localScope.change: Added a generated SAB 21800 body whose unsupported parabola-curve has a three-slot null/reference/repeated-reference raw pointer row. The parser-fed rooted projection preserves exact ordinals and duplicate target indices, while the raw-only point target remains outside the traversed body node set.

evidenceCeiling: The SAB bytes are generated in the test and pass through the local parser, model builder, and rooted projector. The test establishes ordered raw pointer-row retention, duplicate-target preservation, and non-traversal of an unsupported node's raw-only target; it does not establish curve semantics, B-rep validity, external interoperability, native acceptance, or general ACIS support.

implementationReadiness.completedSlice: Mixed null and repeated non-null pointer slots on an unsupported curve are retained at exact ordinals without deduplicating them or traversing the raw-only target.
